rules: Exact HEAD/tree/web tree and actual tracked product, fixture and web bytes must match Git blobs.
Before product initialization, source/src is first, installed/preloaded module origins are rejected, and product file/spec origins are checked.
Product and fixture entry source loaders compile verified source bytes instead of reading ignored cached bytecode.
Product Python workers inherit only a generated source/src PYTHONPATH, never the ambient old installation path.
Both ignored static directories must match the SHA-pinned published exact-head build manifest; current contents cannot become a new baseline.
Later approved initialization checks the actual Console static constant and OAuth route closure directories.
Later approved browser global setup hashes actual Console responses and requires OAuth routes to remain disabled before any test body.
